_note: The quarantine list, the four file-level classifications, the three-step doctrine pass and the five genuinely missing items are all sourced. The canon manifest's file identifiers are not in this workspace and are left null — a file identifier is exactly the kind of value that gets copied into a citation, and an invented one would make a citation that resolves to nothing look like one that resolves.

canon.note: Eighteen system instruments. Titles and file identifiers are not in this workspace. Module 05 carries an open defect on one identifier recorded against two documents, which is what an unverified identifier costs.

quarantineRule: Listed, never opened. There is no preview, no open, no excerpt, no copy and no download control on any row above, and none is added later — the affordance is the leak, not the intent behind it.

steps.title: Doctrine pass
steps.test: Does the material assert a doctrine this portfolio has retired or excluded? If so it does not come back, in any framing.

steps.title: Entity-name pass
steps.test: Does it use an entity name that has been superseded, or one of the four still provisional? An instrument using a superseded name fails the release gate on that ground alone.

steps.title: Capacity pass
steps.test: Does it style anyone in a capacity the control schedule does not assign? The three-capacity protocol is retired and does not return through a recovered file.

doctrinePass.rule: Nothing is regenerated from recovered material without all three. Every recovery action in this module is attached to this gate; a recovery action with no gate attached is a failed implementation.

missingRule: These are in no vault. They are MISSING, not pending — pending implies somebody is producing them, and nobody is. Each has to be requested from the party that holds it.
